folds.heading: ## Planning-history qualification, 2026-11-04 (B23)
folds.body: The opening runtime hold and proposed next preflight are the October 4 planning assignment, not today’s execution authority. AUTH01–AUTH08 remain useful source-era findings: definition shape does not prove native binding, composed registries need explicit activation intent, participant/response/expiry paths need truthful diagnostics, and prose/source corrections cannot rewrite paid frozen commitments. Preserve the incumbent executor/publisher and cause-based actor recipes; these findings do not require a new interpreter or universally mandatory package mechanism. Current code and owners must establish which specific gaps remain when one consumer is selected. This reconciliation implements none of these proposals.
